head: codex/5349-v0918-wp09-provider-tool-adapters
title: [v0.91.8][WP-09] Add bounded provider and governed-tool adapters
body:
Closes #5349

Implements the deterministic mock, bounded permit-authorized HTTPS, verified governed-tool, and explicit lossless compatibility adapters for ADL v2. Receipts are non-blocking audit evidence and are never consulted as execution, publication, or integration gates.

Proof: the aggregate FastWork lane passed dependency/source checks, 54 adapter tests, secret and negative-authority checks, formatting, strict Clippy, exact COTS inventory, and LoC/test budgets. Independent exact-revision review completed with its one actionable validation-runner finding fixed.
